git_sync: Sync a git repository. Pass repo name as parameter, or leave empty to sync all.
run_script: Run a PowerShell script with typed script_name and parameters workflow inputs.
power_aggregation: Trigger hugin-core daily energy aggregation. Runs every 15 minutes and at midnight.
print_news: Fetch news headlines from an RSS feed and print them on the Cashino printer. Configure feed_url, count, and summarize as workflow inputs.
print_weather: Print the yr.no weather meteogram on the thermal printer. Leave yr_id unset to use the configured YR_ID.
print_today: Print today's calendar events and active reminders on the thermal printer. No parameter needed.
print_shopping: Fetch the shopping list from hugin-core and print it on the thermal printer. No parameter needed.
sms_brief: Send a compact daily agenda briefing by SMS.
phone_call: Place a ring-only call. Target can be a Hugin user ID, username/display name, or an E.164 phone number. Configure a 5–60 second ringing window.
